mapper.sql:
FROM learn_task_assignment assignment JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = assignment.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id = student.student_user_id LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization student_class ON student_class.student_id = student.id AND student_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_class.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = student_class.organization_id WHERE assignment.task_id = #{query.taskId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization visible_class JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.class_organization_id = visible_class.organization_id AND teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{query.teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE visible_class.student_id = assignment.student_id AND visible_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND visible_class.status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select:
SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, student_user.username AS student_account, class_organization.id AS class_organization_id, class_organization.organization_name AS class_name, assignment.current_status, assignment.scheduled_date, assignment.claimed_at, assignment.completed_at, assignment.last_transition_at
ORDER BY class_organization.sort_order, student.student_name, assignment.id LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}
